content:
incident-bot: Pager alert — SEV2: API Gateway (edge/gw) 502/504 spike detected. Error rate jumped to ~18% for public-api-prod in us-west-2 starting ~21:51Z. Paging on-call: @sam :rotating_light:

sam: On it. Can someone post the basic curl health check and recent 502 logs? 

maya: I ran quick metric query — upstream 502s from edge-proxy -> api-gateway increased at 21:50Z. Latency for gateway also up ~200ms p50 -> 600ms p50. No obvious deployment in the last hour.

chris: Confirmed, edge proxy logs show a surge of backend 502 responses with pattern: connection reset by peer and http2 stream errors. Looks like pool exhaustion on a subset of api-gateway instances.

sam: OK. Rolling partial mitigation: draining problematic instances from LB and disabling sticky-session routing to test. Can ops do a quick scale up of gw pool?

ops-bot: Autoscale group for api-gateway-prod requested +4 instances (policy: emergency). Estimated spin-up time ~90s.

maya: Adding temporary circuit-breaker on upstream service svc-auth to reduce cascade. Patch applied to edge routing rules (timeout lowered to 800ms, retry disabled).

rebecca: Heads-up — we have active customers on higher-rate ingestions. I'm watching error pages; CS notified and has an FAQ draft. No major outages reported yet but errors visible in health checks for some customers.

sam: Paste of the quick health check I ran: ```bash
curl -sv https://api.redwood.test/health || true
* Connected to api.redwood.test (10.0.5.12) port 443...
* TLS 1.3 connection established
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.test
> 
< HTTP/2 502
< content-type: application/json
< x-edge-proxy-id: gw-12b
{ "error": "bad_gateway" }
```

chris: Noted gw-12b in logs thrashing. Draining started by sam, requests should stop hitting it in ~30s. Also pushed a temporary more-aggressive keepalive and connection backoff on the edge balancer to avoid overflowing backend fds.

maya: New metrics after actions: 502 rate dropped to ~7% at 21:58Z, p50 latency improving. Autoscale instances are healthy and registered. Still seeing tail errors in eu-west-1 but much lower.

sam: Good. Next step: if 5xx < 5% and latency stable for 5m, we'll unpage. For root cause, we need to capture: kernel-level fd exhaustion signs on gw-12b and upstream service svc-auth saturation. Can eng-runtime collect netstat + lsof + recent kernel logs from gw-12b before it's recycled?

chris: Copy. Capturing now: ```bash
ssh gw-12b "sudo ss -s; sudo lsof -nP -p $(pidof edge-proxy) | wc -l; sudo journalctl -u edge-proxy -n 500" > /tmp/gw-12b-dump.txt
```

ops-bot: Artifact gw-12b-dump.txt uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1764509123/gw-12b-dump.txt

rebecca: Customer impact: 12 distinct customers reported 502s in last 15m, mostly short-lived. Logged in support ticket INC-17645 and notified top-10 customers via CS.

sam: Running a controlled traffic re-route test to confirm stability. If stable for 5 minutes, handoff to oncall-secondary and we'll open an investigation ticket.

maya: Quick note: no related infra deploys; there was a config change to svc-auth connection pool yesterday but rollout completed. Might be load pattern and a pool mis-estimate.

chris: Filing a follow-up to check svc-auth connection-provisioning and instrument per-host connection counts. Also adding alert for fd_pressure on gateways.

sam: 22:03Z — 5xx down to 2.1%, latency p50 back to baseline. I'm unpaging but keeping the thread open for investigation. Handoff: @maya will lead RCA, @chris to do instrumentation/alerting, @rebecca to coordinate customer comms.

rebecca: Copy. I'll update the incident log and send the customer follow-up once we have RCA summary.

incident-bot: Incident update recorded: SEV2 -> mitigated; incident id INC-1764509123. Postmortem requested within 72h. 

sam: Leaving notes for next oncall: retained gw-12b dump S3 path, svc-auth upstream saturation suspected, temporary CB/timeouts applied, autoscale + drain mitigated spike. If anything regresses re-open pager. :thumbsup:
